title: POV: You Did 10 Small Things for a Year — You're $5,300 Richer, Your Friends Are Still Broke
description:
10 small habits that can change your life and your money in one year. It's New Year's Eve: your friends are making big resolutions again, and you're quietly $5,300 ahead, without a raise.

In this POV story you'll see the 10 small things you did and what each one was worth: paying yourself first ($50 a week), a 5-minute Sunday money check, the 24-hour rule, cooking 3 more nights a week, canceling forgotten subscriptions, one no-spend day, paying your credit card in full, 10 pages a day, a daily walk, and saving half of every raise.

short2.title: POV: You Only Pay the Minimum on a $3,000 Card… It Takes 15 YEARS 😱
short2.description: $3,000 on a credit card at 22% APR, paying only the minimum (1% + interest): about 15 years and around $4,400 in interest. A fixed $150 a month: about 2 years and roughly $770 in interest. Example estimate; your card's terms may differ.
